description_en: Queries the information about the historical versions of a service
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-service-versions --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --service-name test_oss --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceVersions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the service resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何获取服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的版本数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_zh: 返回查询的历史版本的当前页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回每页显示的历史版本数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Versions.description_en: The historical versions of the service

BuildTime.description_en: The time when the service version was created. The time is displayed in UTC

ImageAvailable.description_en:
Indicates whether the image is available. Valid values:

true: The image is available.

false: The image is unavailable.

unknown: The availability of the image is unknown
ImageAvailable.description_zh:
镜像可用性。可能值：
true：可用。
false：不可用。
unknown：未知

ServiceConfig.description_en: The service deployment configurations. This parameter is returned only if the service is deployed by using a custom image
ServiceConfig.description_zh: 服务部署配置。只有自定义镜像部署才会返回此字段

ServiceRunnable.description_en:
Indicates whether Elastic Algorithm service (EAS) is activated. Valid values:

true: EAS is activated.

false: EAS is not activated.

unknown: The activation of EAS is unknown
ServiceRunnable.description_zh:
eas服务是否启用，可能值：
true：启用。
false：未启用。
unknown：未知
